name: Gang up
summary:
Gang Up is a chaotic social VR game built for fun, teamwork, and unforgettable moments with friends.

Jump into a world where you can hang out, compete, explore, and create your own chaos. Team up with your friends, challenge other players, and see what happens when everyone gets together.

Whether you’re looking for a place to chill with your gang or jump into some friendly competition, Gang Up is all about having fun and making every session your own.

Get your gang together. It’s time to Gang Up!
